verdict.rationale: Statsig documents official Client and Server SDKs, including a React StatsigProvider quickstart, a JavaScript SDK tutorial, and On-Device Eval SDKs. The SDKs handle caching, retries, and networking, and evaluate locally in under 1ms. The docs steer developers to the SDKs over the raw HTTP API, and community users report implementing Statsig at multiple companies. Missing for 10: an enumerated list of supported languages and platforms, and independent hands-on detail on SDK quality or ergonomics.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Update your app's default function (typically App.tsx or Layout.tsx) so that the StatsigProvider component identifier wraps all child components.
After initialization, both Client and Server SDKs evaluate experiments/gates _without a network request_, and typically in less than 1ms.
Abstract the complexity: Statsig handles caching, retry mechanisms, and networking.
Only use this HTTP API directly if no SDK exists for your language or if you have a specific use case that requires direct API access.
checks it live with the JavaScript SDK in your browser console
Have implemented Statsig in two companies as alternatives to LaunchDarkly and loved it both times.
